Opcjonalne, zalecane. Opis jest używany: Optional, recommended. The description is used in categorization rules, previews and duplicate checks.
Opcjonalne. Kontrahent jest używany w re: Optional. The counterparty is used in rules, the transaction list and duplicate checks.
Opcjonalne. Tylko jeśli CSV zawiera goto: Optional. Only use this if the CSV contains bank categories. Otherwise, rules assign a category or it remains unassigned. Do not select the Description column here.

Opcjonalne. Oryginalne ID nadane przez b: Optional. The original bank ID, used only to detect duplicate transactions. The database assigns its own record ID automatically.
